title: heptapleurum pilematophorum
intro: Heptapleurum pilematophorum, commonly known as the "Kadupul Tree" or "Queen of the Night", is a flowering plant species native to Sri Lanka. This plant is valued for its unique flowers that bloom only at night and wilt before dawn. The health benefits of Heptapleurum pilematophorum include its potential to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, although specific bioactive constituents have not been extensively documented.
